p219.title: Attachment Orders & Fraud Prevention
p219.subtitle: Record received court decree / garnishee attachment orders under EPF Act s.10 and review fraud hold claims.
p219.section10_notice: Under Section 10 of the EPF Act, 1952, member provident fund accumulations, nominee amounts, pension, and EDLI benefits are immune from attachment under any decree or order of any court in respect of any debt or liability. Maintenance orders are not exempt. Only recovery orders under the EPF Act itself are accepted. Payments to members are never diverted.
